contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

items.description: sha-256 content address (64 lowercase hex). Normative derivation: the frozen AISE-CONTENT-V1 canonical encoding (see apps/android ContentIdentity).

observationId.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

observedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, `Z` suffix only.

observer.description: Identity of the observing entity (operator id, or sensor+session reference).

subjectRef.description: Stable id of the observed RealityObject.
